schema: CREATE TABLE Purchases (customer_id INTEGER, product_id INTEGER, purchase_date DATE);
correct_query: SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM Purchases GROUP BY purchase_date, customer_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) > 1 ORDER BY customer_id

expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.description: Pushes DISTINCT into a derived table alongside COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) while omitting outer DISTINCT on customer_id, producing duplicate rows when a customer has multiple qualifying dates with different distinct product counts.
expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.query: SELECT customer_id FROM (SELECT DISTINCT customer_id, COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) AS cnt FROM Purchases GROUP BY purchase_date, customer_id) AS t WHERE cnt > 1 ORDER BY customer_id

expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.description: Omits DISTINCT when projecting a strict subset of GROUP BY columns.
expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.query: SELECT customer_id FROM Purchases GROUP BY purchase_date, customer_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) > 1 ORDER BY customer_id
